parameters.query:
INSERT INTO observations (
  observation_id, location_id, observation_time_utc,
  temperature_2m_max, temperature_2m_min, precipitation_sum,
  source, source_url, parser_version, collected_at, updated_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3::timestamptz,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,$10::timestamptz, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (observation_id) DO UPDATE SET
  temperature_2m_max = EXCLUDED.temperature_2m_max,
  temperature_2m_min = EXCLUDED.temperature_2m_min,
  precipitation_sum  = EXCLUDED.precipitation_sum,
  source             = EXCLUDED.source,
  source_url         = EXCLUDED.source_url,
  parser_version     = EXCLUDED.parser_version,
  collected_at       = EXCLUDED.collected_at,
  updated_at         = NOW()
WHERE observations.temperature_2m_max <> EXCLUDED.temperature_2m_max
   OR observations.temperature_2m_min <> EXCLUDED.temperature_2m_min
   OR COALESCE(observations.precipitation_sum, -999) <> COALESCE(EXCLUDED.precipitation_sum, -999)
RETURNING observation_id, (xmax = 0) AS inserted;

INSERT INTO rejects (payload, reason, step, created_at)
VALUES ($1::jsonb, $2, 'contract', NOW())

options.queryReplacement: ={{ JSON.stringify({observation_id: $json.observation_id, city: $json.city, latitude: $json.latitude, longitude: $json.longitude, observation_time_utc: $json.observation_time_utc, temperature_2m_max: $json.temperature_2m_max, temperature_2m_min: $json.temperature_2m_min, precipitation_sum: $json.precipitation_sum}) }}, {{ $json._reason }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO locations (
  location_id, city, latitude, longitude,
  source, source_url, parser_version, collected_at, updated_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8::timestamptz, NOW())
ON CONFLICT (location_id) DO UPDATE SET
  city           = EXCLUDED.city,
  latitude       = EXCLUDED.latitude,
  longitude      = EXCLUDED.longitude,
  source         = EXCLUDED.source,
  source_url     = EXCLUDED.source_url,
  parser_version = EXCLUDED.parser_version,
  collected_at   = EXCLUDED.collected_at,
  updated_at     = NOW()
WHERE locations.city <> EXCLUDED.city
   OR locations.latitude <> EXCLUDED.latitude
   OR locations.longitude <> EXCLUDED.longitude;
